note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: November layering is all about the details: sheer lace tops peeking out at the neckline and wrists under oversized sweaters and argyle knits, brown suede jackets over flared jeans, and knee-high boots to finish. One viral styling trick layers an oversized top over a striped long-sleeve shirt, tying the shirt at the waist for an asymmetrical skirt effect in three colorways, while a 'just add layers' London lookbook pairs the same suede-and-argyle formula with a tote and sunglasses.
trends.title: Layered fall outfits, just add layers — lace peeking under sweaters

trends.details: Evening living rooms glow without going overboard on pumpkins: light-colored sectionals with brown and cream pillows and chunky knit throws, lit fireplaces topped with gold-framed mirrors, crystal chandeliers, and candles and dried hydrangeas and eucalyptus on coffee tables. Slow panning tours at night show the same formula — warm lamp and candlelight, dark wood beams and coffee tables, gallery walls — with one creator proudly noting 'not a pumpkin in sight' for a more refined fall look.
trends.title: Warm-lit evening living rooms, chandeliers and fireplaces

trends.details: Toasty fall makeup is the warm, sun-kissed look beginners are copying: hydrating skincare first, bronzer placed high on cheekbones, temples and forehead and blended into the hairline, terracotta and toasted-teddy blush with pumpkin-and-cinnamon undertones, brown eyeshadow tapped on the lids, tightlined eyes, faux freckles, and glossy nude lips. A 180K-like full-face tutorial follows the same soft-glam grammar — primer, satin foundation, color-correcting concealer, liquid blush, smoky eyes with winged liner, and lip gloss on top.
trends.title: Toasty fall makeup, warm and sun-kissed
